Package com.microservices.reservation.warehouse.responses

Record Class ReservationResponse

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.microservices.reservation.warehouse.responses.ReservationResponse
Record Components:
id - the unique identifier of the reservation
reservedBy - the UUID of the person who made the reservation
warehouse - the ID of the warehouse associated with the reservation
owner - the UUID of the owner of the warehouse
fromDate - the start date of the reservation
toDate - the end date of the reservation
factor - the installment factor related to the reservation
stats - the current reservation statistics
public record ReservationResponse(UUID id, UUID reservedBy, Long warehouse, UUID owner, LocalDate fromDate, LocalDate toDate, InstallmentFactor factor, ReservationStats stats) extends Record
Represents a response containing details about a reservation.

This record provides comprehensive information about a reservation, including its ID, the person who made the reservation, the associated warehouse, reservation dates, installment factors, and reservation statistics.
